newsitem.title: NEPAL: Nepal rupee steady vs US dollar on lower demand.
newsitem.headline: Nepal rupee steady vs US dollar on lower demand.

text.p: The Nepali rupee opened steady at 56.87/89 rupees per US dollar on Wednesday, dealers said.
Dealers said the rates may stay at the same levels for some time as there is no US dollar demand and the supply seems to be good.
Nepal Rastra Bank, the kingdom's central bank, quoted its rupee-dollar rate at 56.75-57.30 rupees per dollar.
Inter-bank call money rates opened at 4.0-4.5 percent on Wednesday, steady compared to the previous close, a dealer said.
"Call rates will remain at this levels, as there is an average growth of 50 basis points in t-bills rate compared to previous," a dealer said.
